title: A Disappointment
text:
A Disappointment. We've only used the yellow mold for making ice cubes. We don't make chocolates and haven't yet tried it with Jello.
As an ice cube tray this is a bit of a disappointment. The cubes are rather small and melt away rapidly. They are cute and do look like Lego blocks but they just don't last long enough to be worth the effort. We also found removing the ice cubes from the mold to be somewhat difficult.

Please note; I received this item in exchange for my review.

description: Ouddy Silicone ice cube molds,Set of 2 Sphere Round Ice Ball Maker & Large Square Ice Cube Mold
Our ice tray combo includes a spherical mold (7 X 4.7 X 1.9inches) and a square mold (6.5 X 4.5 X 2inches), which can freeze six 1.78"ice balls and six 2"ice cubes.

They are larger to melt slower, avoiding watering down flavorous beverages. To make a perfect spherical ice balls, just gently pour the water in through the small hole at the top until they are full, and then put it into your fridge carefully.
